Keep policy arms still while the final truck is lowered; wait for the demonstrator to finish and return. Order: watch, camera, phone, doll, truck.
Wait for final release and demonstrator retreat; do not move policy arms early. Memorized order: watch, camera, phone, doll, truck.
All five demo objects appear in their basket; remain still until the demonstrator completes its return. Order: watch, camera, phone, doll, truck.
Demonstrator has returned home. Begin first target, green watch: cautiously raise and pitch the right gripper toward an overhead approach, maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Align the right gripper vertically above the green watch using calibrated head geometry; keep open and approach gradually.
Lower vertically around the green watch and close the right gripper. Retention will be checked visually during a small lift.
Lift the watch with gripper closed, then bring it toward a central staging spot without crossing the right arm into the left workspace.
Set the retained watch on the central table staging area, open, and lift clear. A slight wrist tilt places it within left-arm reach without arm crossing.
Watch is released on the central-left table. Retract the right arm to its workspace while raising and pitching the left arm for pickup, with separated elbow-up paths.
Approach the staged green watch with the left gripper from above, staying left of center; right arm remains clear.
Lower the left gripper around the staged watch and close; verify retention on the next lift before transporting it to the basket.
Lift the first target, the watch, with left gripper closed and begin carrying it leftward above the other objects.
Watch is visibly retained. Carry it over the front of the policy basket, then lower cautiously for the first placement.
Release the watch inside the basket and lift clear. Begin approaching the second target, black camera, with the right gripper.
Watch is visibly released in the policy basket. Refine right-gripper alignment over the camera and descend with the gripper open.
Center the right jaws on the black camera, close fully, then perform a short vertical lift to check retention.
Camera is visibly retained. Carry it to the central staging area with the right arm remaining in its workspace; keep the gripper closed.
Lower and release the camera onto the central staging surface, then lift clear so the left arm can retrieve it for the second basket placement.
Camera is released on the central-left table. Retract the right arm and approach with the left, keeping their paths separated.
Align the left gripper over the staged camera using the wrist view and lower with jaws open, staying on the left side.
Grasp the camera with the left gripper, lift clear, and begin moving toward the policy basket for the second placement.
Camera remains visibly held. Carry it above the policy basket with rim clearance, keeping the watch undisturbed.
Lower the camera into the basket, release it as the second object, and lift the open left gripper clear.
Camera is released in the basket after the watch. Approach the third target, phone, with the left gripper aligned across its width.
Refine the phone approach from the wrist view, moving slightly forward while descending with the left jaws open.
Close the left gripper across the phone and lift vertically to verify retention before the third placement.
Phone is visibly retained. Carry it high over the back portion of the policy basket for the third placement.
Replan after continuity rejection: lower with small leftward increments away from the reach limit, then release the phone into the basket as the third object.
Phone is released in the basket. Withdraw the left arm while aligning the right jaws across the doll's body for the fourth target.
Use the right wrist view to center the open jaws around the doll's torso while descending cautiously.
Refine doll alignment along its body: lift slightly, shift toward the torso, then lower the open jaws again.
Center on the doll's torso, close the right gripper fully, and lift briefly to verify the fourth target is retained.
Doll is visibly retained. Lift for clearance and carry it toward the central staging area, keeping the right arm on its own side and gripper closed.
The doll slipped and is still on the right table. Return above it with open jaws to retry a more secure grasp; do not proceed to the truck.
Retry a deeper grasp around the doll's head/upper torso, centering from the wrist view before closing.
Center the right jaws on the doll's head, close fully, and lift slowly to check this retry before any lateral transport.
Lift the doll gently and begin a slower central transfer with the right gripper kept fully closed; inspect for slipping before continuing.
Continue the slow transfer toward the center with closed jaws; doll retention is uncertain from the tilted wrist view, so inspect again before release.
The doll is no longer in the jaws. Return to the right workspace and reorient the open gripper to inspect and retry a torso grasp rather than the ears.
Reacquire the doll at its new table position and orient the open jaws across its torso; keep the three placed objects undisturbed.
Descend with open right jaws, correcting lateral alignment across the doll's torso; inspect close-range geometry before closing.
Make a small torso-centering correction, close the right jaws around the doll's body, and test retention with a slow short lift.
The doll's torso now appears securely between the jaws. Lift and transfer slowly toward central staging while maintaining the closed grasp and fixed orientation.
Doll remains retained in the torso grasp. Move to central staging with a slight leftward tool tilt, then lower gently while keeping the right arm on its side.
Release the doll on central staging and withdraw the right gripper; bring the left arm to a separated approach pose with jaws oriented across the doll's torso.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller rotation increments. Withdraw the right arm fully and approach the staged doll's torso with the left open gripper.
Lower the left jaws around the staged doll's torso, then close fully. Keep the right arm clear and verify the grasp before transport.
Lift the doll in the left torso grasp, then begin carrying it above the table toward the policy basket as the fourth object.
Doll remains visibly held. Carry it over the policy basket at clearance height, preserving the stable torso grasp.
Lower and release the doll into the basket as the fourth object, then lift the open left gripper away before handling the final truck.
The doll is released with the first three objects. Approach the final gold truck from above with the right gripper, rotating the jaws across its width.
Lower the open right gripper toward the truck, making a small forward correction along its length before checking close-range alignment.
Center across the truck's width, lower slightly, close fully, and test the final-object grasp with a short lift.
Move the held truck to central staging with a slight leftward tool tilt, then lower gently without crossing the right arm into the left workspace.
Release the truck on central staging, lift and withdraw the right arm, and move the left arm to a separated approach pose for the last pickup.
Approach the staged truck with the left jaws aligned across its width, while withdrawing the right arm further into its workspace.
Lower around the overturned truck, close the left jaws across its body, and perform a short lift to verify the final pickup.
